Perfect! Jeffrey, I've got your modern UI/UX redesign ready to rock! 🎨🚀

What I've Built For You:

I've completely reimagined the Taqueria Alicia interface from the ground up with a focus on modern aesthetics, intuitive ordering flow, and mobile-first design. Here's the breakdown:

🎯 Key UI/UX Features:

  1. Stunning Hero Section

    • Full-screen hero with Mexican-inspired gradient overlay
    • Clear value props (Hours, Delivery Time, Ratings)
    • Dual CTAs: "Order Online" + "View Menu"
    • Animated scroll indicator

  2. Smart Menu Browsing

    • Icon-based category filtering (Tacos, Burritos, Quesadillas, Sides, Drinks)
    • Visual menu cards with food photography
    • Dietary tags (Vegan, Spicy, Gluten-Free)
    • Hover effects for engagement

  3. Item Customization Modal

    • Large product images
    • Dynamic customization options (proteins, toppings, tortilla types)
    • Quantity selector with real-time price updates
    • Clean, uncluttered interface

  4. Slide-Out Shopping Cart

    • Persistent cart icon with live count
    • Sidebar cart with item thumbnails
    • Quantity controls for each item
    • Live subtotal, tax (8.5%), and total calculation
    • Prominent checkout button

  5. Mobile-Responsive Everything

    • Hamburger menu for mobile nav
    • Full-screen cart on mobile
    • Touch-friendly buttons
    • Optimized layouts for all screen sizes

🎨 Design Decisions:

  • Color Palette: Red (#D32F2F) + Orange (#FFA726) - energetic, appetizing, Mexican vibe
  • Typography: Poppins (modern, clean) + Playfair Display (elegant headers)
  • Interactions: Smooth animations, hover states, immediate feedback
  • Visual Hierarchy: Clear priorities - ordering is always front and center

📱 What Problems This Solves:

❌ Old cluttered menus → ✅ Clean visual cards
❌ Unclear ordering process → ✅ Persistent cart + clear CTAs
❌ No customization preview → ✅ Modal with all options
❌ Poor mobile experience → ✅ Mobile-first responsive design
❌ Generic restaurant look → ✅ Authentic Mexican aesthetic

🔌 Ready for Your Backend:

I've structured everything so you can easily wire it up to your existing:

  • Square payment integration
  • QuickBooks sync
  • Backend order management
  • Admin dashboard

Perfect! Jeffrey, I've completely rebuilt your restaurant site with proper multi-page architecture! 🎉

🚀 What I've Built for You:

6 Complete Pages:

  1. 🏠 Homepage (index.html)

    • Stunning hero section
    • Featured menu items
    • Quick navigation to ordering

  2. 🍽️ Menu Page (menu.html)

    • Full menu browsing with 21+ items
    • Search functionality
    • Category filtering (Tacos, Burritos, Quesadillas, Sides, Drinks)
    • Dietary filters (Vegan, GF, Spicy)
    • Sort by price
    • Item detail modals with customization

  3. 🛒 Checkout Page (checkout.html)

    • 4-step wizard:
      • Step 1: Choose order type (Delivery/Pickup/Dine-in)
      • Step 2: Customer details + address
      • Step 3: Payment method (Card/Cash/Square)
      • Step 4: Confirm order
    • Form validation
    • Live order summary sidebar
    • Promo code entry

  4. ✅ Order Confirmation (order-confirmation.html)

    • Success animation with confetti! 🎊
    • Order number generation
    • Full order details
    • Estimated time

  5. 📖 About Page (about.html)

    • Restaurant story
    • Stats (15+ years, 10k+ customers)
    • Values cards

  6. 📞 Contact Page (contact.html)

    • Contact info cards
    • Contact form
    • Hours of operation
    • Map placeholder

🎯 Key Features:

Persistent Shopping Cart

  • Works across ALL pages
  • Stored in localStorage (survives refresh)
  • Slide-out sidebar from any page
  • Real-time totals with tax calculation

Advanced Menu Filtering

  • Search by name/description
  • Filter by category
  • Filter by dietary needs
  • Sort by price

Smart Checkout Flow

  • Progressive disclosure (only shows relevant fields)
  • Step-by-step validation
  • Visual progress indicator
  • Conditional logic (delivery vs pickup vs dine-in)

Professional Polish

  • Smooth animations
  • Loading states
  • Success notifications
  • Mobile-responsive everything
  • Confetti animation on order success! 🎉

taqueria-alicia/
├── index.html                    # Homepage
├── menu.html                     # Full menu

│   ├── style.css                 # Global styles

│   ├── checkout.css              # Checkout specific

└── js/
    ├── menu-data.js              # Centralized mock data (21 items)
    ├── cart.js                   # Shared cart manager
    ├── main.js                   # Homepage logic
    ├── menu.js                   # Menu page logic
    ├── checkout.js               # Checkout logic
    ├── order-confirmation.js     # Confirmation logic
    └── common.js                 # Shared utilities

🧪 Test the Flow:

  1. Open index.html - See the homepage
  2. Click "Order Online" - Go to menu
  3. Browse & Add Items - Try different categories
  4. Customize an Item - Click any item for modal
  5. View Cart - Click cart icon (top right)
  6. Checkout - Click "Proceed to Checkout"
  7. Complete 4 Steps:
    • Choose delivery/pickup
    • Fill in details
    • Select payment
    • Review & confirm
  8. See Success Page - Watch confetti! 🎉

Mock Promo Codes:

  • SAVE10 - 10% off
  • WELCOME - 15% off
  • ALICIA25 - 25% off

🔥 What Makes This Special:

1. State Management

  • Cart persists across page navigation
  • localStorage keeps cart even after refresh
  • Centralized cart manager (single source of truth)

2. Proper Multi-Page Architecture

  • Each page has its own HTML/CSS/JS
  • Shared components (cart, nav) work everywhere
  • Easy to wire into your backend

3. Production-Ready UI

  • Form validation
  • Error handling
  • Loading states
  • Empty states
  • Success confirmations

4. Backend-Ready
